Shreya Kulkarni
Accountant | New Delhi
shreya.kulkarni571@example.com | +91 9646118482

Detail-oriented accounting professional with hands-on experience in accounts payable and GST compliance within a SaaS environment. Comfortable working with Tally for bookkeeping and reconciliations, and familiar with financial modeling to support reporting needs. Available to join after a 15 days notice period.

Experience
Zoho — Mar 2026 - Present
Accountant, On-site
- Managed Accounts Payable cycle for 1,200+ vendor invoices per quarter using Tally, reducing average invoice processing time by 28% through streamlined voucher entry and batching.
- Ensured timely GST filings and reconciliations across multiple state GSTINs, identifying and correcting input tax credit mismatches worth INR 320,000 in a single quarter.
- Prepared working papers and assisted in basic Financial Modeling for monthly cash flow forecasts, improving short-term liquidity visibility and supporting vendor payment scheduling.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams using Jira to track accounting queries and ticketed exceptions; used Git to version-control simple Excel-based model templates and macros for auditability.

Projects
- Vendor Reconciliation Automation: Built standardized Tally voucher templates and reconciliation checklists, cutting manual reconciliation time by ~35% and improving accuracy for payable aging reports.
- GST Filing Tracker: Created a spreadsheet-based tracker with modeled projections to forecast GST liabilities and refund timelines, which reduced late payments by ensuring timely preparations.

Skills
Tally, GST, Accounts Payable
Financial Modeling
Jira, Git

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS

Notice period: 15 days
